community_list_entries.name: Linguistic Loopholes in LLM Unlearning: From a 174-Language Benchmark to Coverage-Aware Unlearning

phase1_classification.kind_reason: The paper introduces an unlearning benchmark spanning 174 language-script pairs and 25 paraphrase types. It tests whether forgetting of knowledge in model weights generalizes, using SimNPO, RMU and GradDiff on TOFU, LUME and LORELEI. It also proposes the COVER method. Only a data subset is released;
